senses.gloss:
ख The second consonant of the Deva Nagari alphabet, being the
aspirate of the proceding; it is written in the Roman character
Kh.

ख n. (-खं)
 1. Heaven.
 2. Sky or ether.
 3. An organ of sense.
 4. Know-
ledge.
 5. Happiness, pleasure.
 6. vacuity.
 7. A dot, a cypher.
 8.
A city, a field.
 9. Action.
 10. Auspiciousness.
 11. Tale.
 12. The
tenth constellation from any given one, or the sun's entrance in-
to it.
 13. Brahma the supreme spirit.
 m. (-खः) A name of the
sun.
 E. खन् to dig, to penetrate, affix ड.
